Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 3/4 cups flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup margarine or butter
1/2 cup peanut butter
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
1 egg
1 teaspoon vanilla
sugar
Hershey kisses

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375. 2 Mix flour, baking soda and salt. Soften butter and mix with peanut butter. 3 Add sugars gradually until creamy and well-blended. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir in flour mix. Roll into one-inch balls, and cover in sugar. 4 Bake on ungreased cookie sheets for 12 minutes. 5 Press an unwrapped kiss into the top of each warm cookie.

About


These make great Christmas gifts, arranged in clear jars with wrapped Hershey kisses interspersed among the cookies. Artistic & delicious!
